summary: Bad-price-action selectivity screen vs the canon book residual losers, with adversarial verify

result.summary: Flow/structure/sequencing screen of 713 trades (275 canon) for residual canon losers, 2025-quantile thresholds, both-year + universe corroboration. One P&L-confirmed loser flag: deltaz_15>q75 AND wicky_10>q50 (aggressive delta into wicky/absorption bars, mostly longs) — canon WR gap -13.9/-19.6pp with flagged canon pl -$496/-$1,149, universe same sign n>=44. One WR-only loser flag: trigdens_30<=6 AND indec_30>0.30 (quiet engine + indecision) — -17.6/-18.4pp canon both years but flagged pl was +$4.3k in 2026, so size-down not cut. Two hypotheses rejected: high trigger density is a WINNER tell (not chop), and post-loss sequencing is the STRONGEST canon cell (66.7% WR both years) — no stand-down rule. Bonus winner context: day-after-red + bbw squeeze = 50-57% canon WR, +17-21pp universe. NULLs: churn_flow_30 (sign flips everywhere), deltaz/bigprint/cvddiv/yday_red/prior_ct alone, trigdens-high x churn-low interaction. cvddiv_30==1 is a 4-cell-consistent loser but underpowered (2026 canon n=8) — watch item only.
nulls: churn_flow_30 (all quantiles q25/q50/q75): canon sign FLIPS between years at every threshold (e.g. <=q75: +21.2pp 2025, -15.9pp 2026). Low |delta|/vol two-sided tape is NOT a canon loser flag. NULL.
trigdens-high AND churn_flow-low (the suggested chop interaction): never passes canon bar in either direction. NULL.
churn_flow<=q25 AND trigdens<=q75: canon -12.4/-11.1pp but universe gaps only -4.2/-5.7 with the churn_flow single feature sign-flipping — treat as fragile, not reportable.

deltaz_15 alone (q25/q50/q75 and |z| tails): no split passes both years on canon with universe corroboration; >q75 alone is -16.0pp 2025 but -2.5pp 2026. NULL — only bites combined with wicky_10 (finding B).
bigprint_15 alone: bimodal (0 or capped 15); q50 split sign-flips across years (-14.3 then +7.2). NULL.
cvddiv_30==1: directionally a loser in all 4 cells (canon -9.2/-22.7pp; universe -2.9/-19.4pp) but fails the bar — 2025 canon gap <10pp and 2026 canon n=8. Honest NULL / watch item, driven by 2026.
trigdens_30<=q25(6) alone: -19.5pp 2025 canon but only -3.2pp 2026. Fails.
prior_ct>=1 alone: +19.5pp 2025 canon, 0.0pp 2026. NULL. prior_ct>=2: n=1-2 in canon, unusable.
prior_pl>0 (green day so far): sign flips (+5.5 then -12.7 canon). NULL.
yday_canon_red==1 alone: canon +7.2pp 2025 / -8.6pp 2026, sign flip. NULL.
E4 & prior_loss==0 (canon -23.5/-13.5pp): real but it flags 101/79 trades carrying +$10.1k/+$18.1k pl — it is just the complement/restatement of the prior_loss winner cell, not an actionable cut.

Multiplicity warning: ~700 splits tested; 31 passed the nominal canon+universe direction bar. Most universe gaps among nominal passes are 1-4pp (direction-only). Only finding B has both-year negative realized canon P&L; only findings A/B/C have universe gaps >=5pp both years. Everything else nominally passing should be treated as noise-level.
